The '''Chillwater Crag''' was a canyon located in the northern part of the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Ilum]] in the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Chillwater Crag appears as an area on Ilum in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
